title: Wolves at the Fire
text: Eyes ring the camp in the dark, green and steady, coming closer each time the fire burns down. You can hear them breathing. Once, very softly, comes something that sounds like laughter.

options.label: Drive them off with fire before they come any closer.
Throw them the food, hoping a full pack is a patient one.

outcomes.text: The pack eats and goes, taking the food and the night's rest with it.

options.label: The wisest sings to them, hoping the laughter was only wind.

outcomes.text: The wolves lie down to listen. In the morning they are still there, waiting to run with you.
The song is not to their taste.
